scope:
Actual full-H tail continuation with all core modes and three controls.

Unknowns are the complete Fourier field, all M planar support coefficients,
and physical delta/LB/vp.  Three extra boundary equations prescribe actual
c2/c4/c6.  The representation gauge and both reference charts are preserved.
Every accepted coupled candidate is checked against a fresh complete
nonlinear finite tail, with the original outer and final-audit gates.
Accepted inner Newton iterates are saved only as unaccepted recovery points.

This changes the prefix metric.  It is not fixed-g spectral refinement,
an infinite-tail closure, or a complete closed-surface reach certificate.
The optional local check forbids a worker and uses the official full-H tail
tangent only at the exact accepted baseline; it never reports a new solve.

fresh_fixed_physical_merit.scope:
Fresh actual M+3 continuation with fixed S, disk QR and domain observations.

The accepted all-core baseline and original complete actual-J warm construction
remain unchanged. The original outer coupling method and complete actual new-H
tests remain unchanged. This entry changes the Newton correction norm, explicitly,
and adds lossless observations of rejected-domain blocks. It does not reuse a
pending q105 affine state or its different H0 response for another target.

configuration.weights_definition: target c2/gauge for log c2; complete physical core scales/gauge for c4+; 1 for delta/LB/vp

explicit_accepted_field_secant.scope:
Use two accepted full fields as a secant predictor for the actual BVP.

Only the initial guess changes. Both input surfaces must have completed the
original actual-tail and physical audits. Their gauge, spectrum, reference
charts and tail problem agree; their physical prefix profiles may differ.
Every new candidate still runs the original full Newton, true-H nonlinear
tail, full Jacobian, final audit, RMS and physical boundary acceptance gates.
This predictor is not a control derivative or an accepted solution.
The optional initial-height hold subtracts a C2 quintic taper from the warm
height field only. This enables exact reuse of the current audited tail at
the first outer anchor; every changed H still requires the original solve.
explicit_accepted_field_secant.previous_field_evaluation: complete accepted numerical cubic at the current material nodes
